description: Source code for a multi-window OpenGL application using ANGLE, involving window creation, rendering, and event handling.

classes.name: MultiWindowSample
classes.description: A class inheriting from SampleApplication that manages multiple windows, rendering, and user interaction.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application, creates windows, and sets up OpenGL context.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, specifically deletes the shader program.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Updates rotation and processes window messages.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders content across multiple windows with transformations.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing to prevent double swapping.
